findings.claim: The premature terminal projection (COMPLETE/DONE with consumed completion counters) ships uncorrected in the final artifact, and the corrective plan revision 8 schedules review/sycophancy/verification/archive but never a signed correction of the false projection, so progress.json/position.json will remain permanently falsified after archive.
findings.evidence: The diff still sets "implementation_status": "COMPLETE" and "status": "DONE" for v3-devtools-time-travel, "changes_completed": 3, "implementation_completed": 3, position.json "status": "COMPLETE" with progress done 35/63, while acceptance task 10 reads "[ ] 10 ... artifact-only adversarial review; verify and archive only after both gates pass" and tasks.md still shows "- [ ] 10 ... (IN_PROGRESS)". The round-2 judge's suggested fix required correcting the projection "through whatever signed path exists ... once task 10's gates actually pass"; the new current-waypoint.json exactNextCommand ("Complete v3-devtools-time-travel task 10 adversarial review, sycophancy gate, signed verification, and archive.") omits any projection-correction step, and the mitigation exists only as prose in evidence/README.md ("The change must not be archived on the terminal projection alone"). The global counters (implementationCompleted 35, changes_completed 3) have already consumed the premature completion.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the signed corrective course (plan revision 8's next-work chain) with an explicit post-gate step that corrects progress.json/position.json/current-waypoint.json through the signed transition API once the round-3 verdict and sycophancy screen pass — or, if no such API path exists, record that as a control-plane defect in the phase postmortem rather than only this change's review folder, so the falsified projection is not silently treated as resolved.

findings.claim: The round-3 chronology fix leaves the current artifact internally contradictory: checkpoint files record the iteration-1 terminate decision at 20:15:30Z while state.json records the same decision at 20:20:06Z, so the checkpoints are neither point-in-time records nor the 'final-state mirrors' decisions.md now claims they are.
findings.evidence: Current checkpoints/45bed4e9.json (and f0578e81.json, 9100ef56.json, and the 2026-08-29_20-32-27Z history copies) contain iteration_history[0] with "decision": "terminate", "timestamp": "2026-08-29T20:15:30Z", while current state.json contains iteration_history[0] "timestamp": "2026-08-29T20:20:06Z" for the same event. decisions.md states "helper-produced checkpoint files are final-state mirrors rather than reliable point-in-time chronology", but the restored checkpoint content no longer mirrors the final state; meanwhile reflection.json still claims "all five blocking constraints pass with exact evidence traceability" for the blocking evidence-and-fixture-integrity constraint.
findings.suggested_fix: Either regenerate the current artifact's checkpoint files from the corrected final state (so 'final-state mirror' is literally true) while keeping the 20-20-25Z snapshot byte-immutable, or amend decisions.md/reflection.json to state precisely that checkpoint files are stale mirrors of the superseded first write and that state.json is the sole chronological authority.

findings.claim: The generated projections disagree about the current signed revision: the corrective plan revision 8 advanced the waypoint and position files to revision 339 but did not regenerate the phase-level projections, which remain stamped at revision 338 with the pre-correction content.
findings.evidence: current-waypoint.json and position.json show "planRevision": 8, "revision"/"derivedRevision"/"sourceRevision": 339, updatedAt 2026-08-29T20:29:47Z, and position-reminder.txt reads "GENERATED BY kbd-runtime at revision 339"; progress.json still shows "derivedRevision": 338, "sourceRevision": 338, last_updated 2026-08-29T20:15:21Z, and tasks.md still carries "<!-- generated by kbd-runtime; source revision 338 -->". The evidence/README.md claim that plan revision 8 makes task 10's gates "the exact next work" is therefore not reflected in the phase progress projection an auditor would read.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate (or have the runtime regenerate) progress.json and tasks.md from source revision 339 so all signed projections agree, or document in evidence/README.md that phase-level projections lag the corrective plan revision and which file is authoritative.

findings.claim: exactNextCommand changed from an executable command string to a prose sentence, which any consumer that dispatches the field as a command will fail on.
findings.evidence: The prior value was "/kbd-apply v3-devtools-entity-inspection"; the new value is "Complete v3-devtools-time-travel task 10 adversarial review, sycophancy gate, signed verification, and archive." — mirrored verbatim as "Next command:" in position-reminder.txt, whose header instructs agents to read it as their first tool call every turn.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep exactNextCommand in the established command form (e.g., a /kbd-* invocation or a defined no-op marker) and carry the prose description in a separate field, or confirm no automation parses exactNextCommand as an executable string.
